title: Character Counter
description: Count characters, words, lines, paragraphs, and bytes in the browser without sending text to the server.
metaDescription: Count characters, words, lines, paragraphs, and bytes in the browser without sending text to the server.

form.title: Count text
form.description: Type or paste text to see counts update in real time.

input.title: Text
input.label: Text to count
input.placeholder: Type or paste your text here.
input.privacy: Counting happens in your browser. The text is not sent to the server.

limit.title: Optional limit
limit.description: Use this when you need to check a character maximum for form fields or descriptions.
limit.label: Character limit
limit.invalid: Enter a positive integer from 1 to 1,000,000. Invalid values are ignored.

share.description: By default, the link stores only the configured limit.
share.includeContent: Include text in the shared link

share.publicWarning: Links with text expose the content to anyone who receives the URL.

privacy.question: Is the text sent to the server?
privacy.answer: No. Analysis happens in the browser. Text only enters the page URL if you enable the option to include text in the link.

spaces.question: What is the difference between characters with and without spaces?
spaces.answer: The no-spaces count removes spaces, tabs, and line breaks. The main count preserves everything you typed.

emoji.question: Does an emoji count as one character?
emoji.answer: When supported by the browser, emoji and letters with combining marks are counted as one visible grapheme.

wordVariation.question: Why can word counts vary?
wordVariation.answer: Editors and platforms may use their own rules for abbreviations, symbols, hashtags, and languages. This tool uses browser segmentation with a fallback.

sharing.question: Can I share already filled text?
sharing.answer: Yes, but only after enabling the option to include text in the link. Use that only when recipients are allowed to read the content.

seo.about: The counter calculates characters with spaces, characters without spaces, words, lines, non-empty lines, paragraphs, sentences, and UTF-8 bytes in the browser. Byte counts are useful for systems with storage or payload limits, especially with accents and emoji.
seo.howToUse: Type or paste text in the main field. Add an optional limit to see remaining or exceeded characters. Shared links preserve the limit by default; include text in the link only if it can be public to whoever receives the URL.
